summary: Ubuntu 12.10 (Quantal Quetzal) was released on 18 October 2012. Features: Web Apps integration (launch web services from the desktop), improvements to Unity, Python 3 as default on the desktop (Python 2 still in archive). Preview of Ubuntu for Phones announced. 'Quetzal' is a colorful Central American bird; 'Quantal' evoked quantum leap.
notes: Unsupported since 2014-05-16. Kernel 3.5. First release where Python 3 became the default Python on desktop images.
